facts.claim: User-scope file is ~/.qwen/settings.json; hooks live under top-level key hooks.PreToolUse[] as {matcher, sequential?, hooks:[{type:'command', command, name?, timeout?}]}
Matcher is an unanchored regex over the runtime tool id; '', '*' or '.*' match all; Claude Code names such as Bash are accepted as exact aliases
timeout is in seconds, default 60; values >= 1000 are read as milliseconds for back-compat; non-numeric values fall back to 60 s
No fail-closed switch exists for command hooks
facts.source: grep of https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/v0.26.3/docs/users/features/hooks.md and https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/v0.26.3/packages/core/src/hooks (only an internal failClosedResult for hook-system crashes, which blocks only TodoCreated/TodoCompleted: https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/v0.26.3/packages/core/src/hooks/hookEventHandler.ts#L959-L972)

facts.claim: Exit 0: a JSON object on stdout controls behaviour; other stdout is plain text kept as a system message for PreToolUse. Exit 2: blocking, stdout ignored, stderr fed to the model. Any other exit: non-blocking error, execution continues
PreToolUse decision is hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision allow|deny|ask plus permissionDecisionReason; allow does not skip normal permission checks
ask falls back to deny in headless --prompt runs and background subagents, and is treated as deny in ACP sessions
Input rewrite: hookSpecificOutput.updatedInput replaces the whole tool input (not merged); a non-object value stops the call; ignored from async hooks
Timeout: the hook process is killed and the result is outcome 'timeout' with success false, which the aggregator treats as an error, not a deny, so the tool call proceeds (fail-open)
Stdout that starts with '{' but is not valid JSON is a non-blocking error and is ignored (call proceeds)
Shell tool id is run_shell_command; MCP tools are named mcp__<server>__<tool>; the hook input has no separate MCP server field
Common output field continue:false (with stopReason) stops execution of the whole turn, not just the call
disableAllHooks:true, --safe-mode or --bare turn all hooks off; project hooks load only in a trusted folder
